headline: Collections and adjusted profit climb, guidance raised
summary_short: Adjusted EPS rose 20.0% y/y to NOK 0.66 and adjusted net profit climbed 21.8% y/y to NOK 246M, as cash collections grew 10.3% y/y to NOK 1,665M on unsecured collection performance of 117% of forecast (vs 112% a year ago).
summary_long: Adjusted EPS rose 20% y/y to NOK 0.66 and adjusted net profit rose 21.8% y/y to NOK 246M, with the company tracking ahead of its 2026 earnings and dividend targets. Cash collections grew 10.3% y/y to NOK 1,665M on 117% collection performance (vs 112% a year ago); NOK 1.3B was invested in new portfolios this quarter, lifting ERC to NOK 28.9B. Leverage was 2.1x with roughly EUR 320M of liquidity. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance — EPS to at least NOK 2.25 (from NOK 2.10), ROE to ~16% (from 14%), and portfolio investments to at least NOK 4B (from NOK 3.5B) — citing the ahead-of-target trend and plans to keep leverage low enough for full dividend distribution.
